proof_scope: Quadratic collar extensions and radially decreasing raw convolutions pass smooth Stokes symmetry and gradient Cauchy-Schwarz to bounded collar potentials; corrected smoothings are not claimed decreasing. Normalized finite tuple maximization with multiplicity-squared tie break yields the sharp collar estimate. Explicit shifted maxima have uniform convergence and finite quadratic total mass; strict sublevel comparison plus layer integration bounds their energies. Weighted bounded capacity continuity and positive cutoffs give the weaker constant2^(n+2) for all bounded E0 potentials, including zero energies and n=1. Mixed truncation energies and weighted deep-set bounds, including ties, give2nC_nE/T test error and continuity for possibly nonuniformly bounded approximants with bounded limits. No unbounded limiting product imported.
